description: This is a Java JUnit test class for testing the ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategy, specifically its behavior in substituting placeholders within policy entries for the ModifyPolicyEntries command in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the substitution strategy behavior, including immutability and placeholder replacement logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that the ModifyPolicyEntriesSubstitutionStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheSameCommandInstanceWhenNoPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method returns the original command when no placeholders are present in the policy entries.

methods.name: applyReturnsTheReplacedCommandInstanceWhenPlaceholderIsSpecified
methods.description: Tests that the apply method correctly replaces placeholders within policy entries.
